candidates.definition_line: Same nature, same register, the standard you hold yourself to
candidates.face_teaser: You trust your own counsel first. Self-reliance is a strength, and now and then a wall others can’t get past. You begin without waiting for permission and finish without needing rescue. The art is knowing the moment standing alone costs more than it’s worth.
candidates.family_clause: the self the other four energies turn around

family_element.appetite: identity, autonomy, and the standard you hold yourself to
family_element.notAlone: not pride alone, but the self the other four energies turn around

__ore.note: TG corpus — the K2 generation source (kept per REA_03 §2.4)

rulingRealm.phrase: Inner Validation — the ego's private standard
rulingRealm.desc: The part of a person that measures everything against their own internal benchmark before anything else. Not comparison with others — comparison with the self. Self-sufficiency is not a strategy here; it is the default operating mode.

gifts: Unwavering conviction under genuine pressure — the same person in every room, every context, every crisis
Never loses themselves in what others want; the core standard holds regardless of what the environment offers
Those who earn entry into real trust receive something exceptionally durable and reliable
shadows: The self-referencing loop has no natural interrupt — genuinely difficult to know when wrong
Loneliness of completeness: surrounded by people and still fundamentally alone unless extraordinary peers are present
New information that contradicts existing conviction gets processed as irrelevant rather than challenging
__ore.hiddenDynamic: Beneath the self-sufficiency is a deep need for peers who are genuinely equal — not admirers, not subordinates, but someone who can actually meet them at the level they operate. The specific loneliness is not about being alone. It is about being surrounded by people who engage with the surface rather than the depth.

outputs.desc: The same person in every room, every context, every crisis — pressure reveals you rather than reshaping you.
You never lose yourself in what others want; the core standard holds regardless of what the room offers.
Those who earn entry into your real trust receive something exceptionally durable and reliable.

frictions.desc: Your self-reference has no natural brake, which makes it genuinely hard to know when you're wrong.
You can be surrounded by people and still fundamentally alone unless a genuine equal is present.
Information that contradicts your conviction tends to get filed as irrelevant rather than taken as a challenge.

career.mechanism: 比肩 → independent judgment, exceptional depth in native domain
career.text: Excels in roles requiring sustained conviction and independent judgment. The self-amplification produces unusual depth. Collaboration is structurally harder because the reference point is always internal — genuine compromise feels like compromise of the standard itself.

relationships.mechanism: 比肩 → peer dynamics, identity pressure, resource contention with equals
relationships.text: Needs a peer who can actually meet them — not someone who defers. Tends to attract people who want to be near the self-sufficiency rather than genuine equals. The pattern: respected and relied upon, but not truly known.

wealth.mechanism: 比肩 → independent income, personal standards drive earning
wealth.text: Earns through their own effort and internally validated standards. Won't monetize things they don't believe in. Independent income sources strongly preferred over institutional dependency.

health.mechanism: 比肩 → self-monitoring calibrated to output, depletion unrecognized
health.text: Tends not to recognize depletion because the self-monitoring system is calibrated to output. Runs on conviction past the point where the body signals readiness to stop. Rest has to be decided, not felt.

retired_2026-09-20_evaluation_rulings.definition_line: Same nature, same register — the standard you hold yourself to

helping.lived: Those years made you an equal in your family more than a child or a dependant. You stood on your own feet among your relatives, and they treated your word as worth the same as theirs.
helping.ahead: Brothers, sisters and cousins become allies in these ten years, and the household runs on shared effort. You carry your own share at home, and your relatives carry theirs without being asked.

heavy.lived: In those years you kept your own counsel at home and asked your family for very little. The distance grew quietly, and what carried you was the one relative who treated you as an equal.
heavy.ahead: Pride runs the household in these years, with everyone at home insisting on their own way. The quarrels shrink once each person has a clear part, and you come through by doing yours without keeping score.

helping.lived: Your progress in those years came from peers who were your equals, people you learned beside more than beneath. You set your own standard and met it, and the confidence lasted.
helping.ahead: Self-reliance pays in these ten years. You teach yourself what you need and find equals to train beside, and you come out more capable on your own terms than before.

heavy.lived: Stubbornness slowed you in those years, because you refused help that would have saved time. You did everything the hard way on your own, and you came out with skills nobody had handed you.
heavy.ahead: Comparison with peers drives you hard in these years, and the standard you hold yourself to leaves little ease. You keep growing because one equal works beside you instead of against you.

helping.lived: Friendships among equals defined those years, with people who matched your pace and asked nothing extra. You found a few friends who met you level, and you have kept some of them since.
helping.ahead: These ten years bring friends who stand beside you as equals, people with their own lives and their own strength. Your circle stays small and solid, and you trust it more than any crowd.

heavy.lived: During those years you held yourself apart from most groups, sure that few people matched your standard. Your circle shrank to one or two, and you found those one or two were enough.
heavy.ahead: Company that truly matches you grows scarce in these years, and crowded groups wear you out quickly. One steady friend carries the decade, and you value that friend more than a full calendar.
